alignments.note: מֵאֵת + name rendered as the single possessive Jehovah's; the compound preposition's relation is written inside the genitive and no separate English word is spent on it, so the three share one unit headed on the name (rules 30, 49). Reviewed as a large-source unit and retained: no English word answers to מִן or אֵת apart from the possessive. Margin 'Hebrew from Jehovah' read and set aside (rule 38).
הָיְתָה takes the copula is, as הָיָה carries the clause's frame (rule 21).

doing is a noun the ASV supplies for the possessive Jehovah's to stand on; rule 40 marks such a noun added under rule 20, and dropping it leaves הָיְתָה still holding its is. Competing reading: 'is doing' as הָיָה's rendering, with doing nominalizing the coming-about the verb predicates.

review_notes: Corrected: doing moved out of the הָיָה unit to its own added unit; it is a noun supplied for the possessive Jehovah's to stand on (rule 40's closing sentence, rule 20), and הָיְתָה keeps only is. The three-morpheme מֵאֵת יְהוָה → Jehovah's fusion was reviewed and retained (rules 30, 49).
